title: Hazel and the Undertow
author: Jude Underhill
blurb: Emrys Kavanagh, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
